name: Mirror Fight
overview: Japanese tokusatsu television series which ran from April 1 to June 28, 1974 on Tokyo Channel 12 (now TV Tokyo). It aired on every Monday to Friday from 18:00 to 18:27. Similar to the also low budget show, Ultra Fight, the show features re-edited battle scenes from Mirrorman, as well as new battles using suits from the show and suits from attractions. The battles are in a confrontation style of Mirrorman and a monster.
